title: Blackwater Joe's Canoe Rental, Cabins and Camping

services.name: Canoe Rentals
services.desc: If you're comparing Blackwater River canoe rentals in Escambia County and wondering what you actually get for the day, here's the plain answer: you check in mid-morning, we shuttle you upstream, and you drift back down to our landing by 5 p.m. Most groups spend four to six hours on the water, and a good chunk of that is spent parked on a white sand bar. Here's how a real day with us goes, hour by hour. Most folks roll in between 9 and 10. You'll park at our landing on Shammah Road in Holt, an easy drive east from Pensacola and Milton, and check in at the office. Canoe rentals start around $30 per person - check current rates when you book - and that covers your boat, paddles, life jackets

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Explore the scenic Blackwater River in a rented canoe for just $30 per person, per day/trip. Enjoy anything from a 1-hour float to an overnight adventure. Shuttle service is included with all rentals, for a 5 PM return.
